newsitem.title: CANADA: Noranda's Heath Steele mine still closed.
newsitem.headline: Noranda's Heath Steele mine still closed.

text.p: Noranda Inc said on Monday that its Heath Steele zinc mine in New Brunswick was still closed after an accident on Friday that sent four workers to hospital.
"They are re-evaluating the operation," Noranda spokesman Gilles Gratton said. "I don't know when they'll be back in production."
He said the company would make a decision by the end of today about whether the mine would be back in operation on Tuesday.
The mine produces 2,700 tonnes of ore a day.
The provincial mines ministry, the union, the company and an independent investigator were looking into safety standards at the mine.
The decision to re-open operations depended on the progress of the investigation, Gratton said.
Operations were suspended on Friday after four miners came into contact with carbon monoxide and carbon dioxide.
It was the second mishap at the mine in less than a month.
On November 4, one miner was killed and another injured after a mine explosion.
